    AIController
    Controller of a player moved by the machine (Template Method): AIController.nextActions(domain.Player, domain.Match) is the fixed part (it decides again only after its reaction time) and AIController.decide(domain.Player, domain.Match) is what each profile does.
    Ball
    The real ball of a match.
    BallSkin
    A ball of the store catalog.

    A match of the tournament bracket: which two teams play it, in which round, and how it ended.
    DOPOSoccer
    Facade of the domain: the only class the interface talks to (Facade pattern).
    DOPOSoccerException
    Error of the game: an invalid choice, an action that cannot be done at that moment, or an option that is still under construction.
    Effect
    Something that changes what a player can do for some seconds.
    Entity
    Anything that moves on the field: the players, the ball and the fake balls.
    FakeBall
    Fake ball of the Illusion shot.
    GameCharacter
    A character: a country (a team) with a power shot.
    GameMode
    Game mode: how many matches are played.
    Goal
    Goal area of one side.
    Match
    A match between two players.
    MatchType
    Rule that says when a match ends and who wins (Strategy pattern).
    PhysicsEngine
    Adapter of the physics library dyn4j (Adapter pattern).
    Player
    A player on the field: a character controlled by a person or by the machine, with the stats of its profile.
    PlayerController
    Who decides the actions of a player: a person with the keyboard or the machine (Strategy pattern).
    PlayerProfile
    Progress of a player: its points, its stats and what it bought in the store.
    PowerShot
    The unique power shot of a character (Strategy pattern).
    ScoreBoard
    Goals of each side during a match.
    Settings
    Settings of the game: volume of the music and of the sound effects, from 0 to 100.
    Stadium
    The field in one of the three resolutions, with a goal at each side.
    Stats
    Stats of a player, from 1 to 10.
    StunEffect
    Stunned: the life of the player reached 0 because of the rival's kicks or power shots.
    TournamentMode
    Tournament of 8 teams against the machine: quarterfinals, semifinal and final.
    Wallet
    Points of a player: they are won playing and spent in the store.
